nodes.summary: Snedecor's `F` law (Casella–Berger, Definition 5.3.6): for independent `V₁ ~ χ²_{d₁}` and `V₂ ~ χ²_{d₂}` with `d₁, d₂ ≥ 1`, `(V₁ / d₁) / (V₂ / d₂)` has density `Γ((d₁ + d₂)/2) / (Γ(d₁/2) Γ(d₂/2)) · (d₁/d₂)^{d₁/2} x^{d₁/2 - 1} (1 + d₁ x / d₂)^{-(d₁+d₂)/2}` on `x > 0`.
nodes.title: Snedecor's `F` law

nodes.summary: Student's `t` law (Casella–Berger, Definition 5.3.4): for independent `Z ~ N(0, 1)` and `V ~ χ²_k` with `k ≥ 1`, `Z / √(V / k)` has density `Γ((k + 1)/2) / (√(k π) Γ(k/2)) · (1 + t²/k)^{-(k+1)/2}`.
nodes.title: Student's `t` law

nodes.summary: For an i.i.d. sample `X₁, …, Xₙ ~ N(μ, v)` with `n ≥ 2` and `v > 0`, `√n (X̄ - μ) / S` with `S² = ∑ (Xᵢ - X̄)² / (n - 1)` has the Student `t` law with `n - 1` degrees of freedom.
nodes.title: One-sample `t` statistic

nodes.summary: Hoeffding's central limit theorem (1948, §7): for an i.i.d. sample from `μ` and a symmetric square-integrable kernel `h` of degree `m`, `√n (U_n - θ)` converges in distribution to `N(0, m² σ₁²)`, where `θ = E h` and `σ₁² = Var h₁`.
nodes.title: Hoeffding's central limit theorem

not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.
